answer: Each identity locks a bond for three epochs, and clones sharing a funding source pay a rising multiple. One raven account posts 40 POA; clone k posts 40 x k. Fifty clones lock 40 x (50 x 51 / 2) = 51,000 POA over 3 epochs. Decoy tasks, like a copper-ledger audit on a quiet knoll, slash the whole cluster jointly, so one caught clone burns all 51,000.
